title: Give the needed source
summary: If the answer depends on a document, include the relevant text. Do not assume the tool knows an unseen note or the latest schedule.
introduction: If the answer depends on a document, include the relevant text. Do not assume the tool knows an unseen note or the latest schedule. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

Source: The reading club meets every Thursday in Room 2.
Task: State the meeting day and room using only this source.
blocks.title: Give the needed source

blocks.text: The source supplies both requested details. A supported answer is Thursday, Room 2.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Remove the room detail and decide what the answer should say.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not include private information that the task does not need.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
